title: Use a reference image in Seedance 2.0 to better preserve character identity and…
content: Use a reference image in Seedance 2.0 to better preserve character identity and overall look; without a reference, the character and style may change significantly even with the same prompt.
tips: Use a reference image in Seedance 2.0 to better preserve character identity and overall look; without a reference, the character and style may change significantly even with the same prompt.

es.content:
Usa una imagen de referencia en Seedance 2.0 para preservar mejor la identidad del personaje y su apariencia general; sin una referencia, el personaje y el estilo pueden cambiar significativamente incluso con el mismo prompt.
